### Context

The local test `node --test test/profile-theme.test.mjs` turns a saved dark theme into light. Testing supported the explanation that a later default-theme step overwrites the saved choice. No earlier report matched, and nothing was blocked.

### What is broken

After a refresh, the account page switches a saved dark theme back to light.

### Why it is broken

The page sets the theme twice. First it loads the saved choice from the profile service, which returns dark. Then a separate step that applies a default theme runs afterward and writes light over it (`src/profile-theme.ts:62`). With that later step turned off, the page stays dark.

### How to fix it

Skip the default theme step once a saved theme has loaded, so a refresh keeps dark instead of resetting to light. This is a small change to one step. Choose hotfix because the fix is small and all safety checks pass.
